name: Logistic Regression
description: Binary logistic regression of a 0/1 (or boolean) response on one or more numeric predictors, fitted by iteratively reweighted least squares (Newton-Raphson). coefficients mode returns one row per term with the log-odds coefficient, standard error (classical or HC1 sandwich), Wald z and p, the confidence interval on the log-odds scale, the odds ratio, and the model-level McFadden pseudo R2 and AUC; predict mode adds the predicted probability and the 0/1 class. An optional L2 penalty keeps perfectly separated data finite.

x.title: Predictors
x.description: One or more numeric predictor columns; every predictor is a term of the model.

y.title: Response
y.description: Binary response column: numeric with values 0/1, or boolean. Both classes must be present.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: coefficients returns one row per term with the fit statistics; predict returns the input rows plus probability and prediction.

robust.title: Standard errors
robust.description: none uses the inverse Fisher information; hc1 uses the heteroskedasticity-consistent sandwich estimator with the n/(n-p) correction.

max_iterations.title: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: Upper bound on Newton-Raphson iterations; positive.

tolerance.title: Convergence tolerance
tolerance.description: Stop when the largest coefficient change is below this value; positive.

l2.title: L2 penalty
l2.description: Optional ridge penalty added to the diagonal of X'WX for the non-intercept terms; 0 disables it.

alpha.title: Significance level
alpha.description: Confidence level of the log-odds interval: 1 - alpha. Must be in (0, 1).

output.title: Probability column
output.description: Name of the probability column added by predict mode.
